source.description: Accepted design comparison against baseline 0a949cf. The three changes are now implemented in the working tree with the agreed broader scope. These fixed previews record the design discussion; use the parent catalog for current behavior maps.

included: Original and Proposed share the same start and outcome. New transitions are marked proposed and never become available in Exploration.
Only the affected route is shown. System checkpoints are simulated; no product effects occur.
Confirmed stale revision; one valid name edit. Latest saved reasoning effort changed independently.
Not an auto-merge proposal. Same-field conflict choices and uncertain-commit reconciliation need separate implementation design. The existing explicit discard path remains available.
omitted: This comparison is not an exhaustive UI or concurrency model. Open the parent atlas for other journeys.
No live app or usability testing, provider requests, account changes or automatic merging. This is the original design study, not the current app rendering.

Counts distinguish intentional controls from system events. Do not treat grouped transitions as measured clicks. Cancel/retry loops are retained as alternatives and excluded from the straightforward before/after route.

comparisons.label: Saul: recover without retyping the draft
comparisons.detail: Highest recovery cost, larger implementation. Current: discard the draft, reconstruct the edit, save. Proposed: retain it, review latest values, explicitly reapply the selected edit, then save. The benefit is preserved work, not a claimed bulk click saving. No automatic merge or overwrite. If a field changed on both sides, require a field choice; read failure or another stale save must retain the draft. This fixture covers a confirmed stale revision with one non-overlapping name edit, not uncertain delivery.
